purpose: Own the post-acquisition entry policy of the autonomous product without changing the transferable Project Kernel family contract or the Form-preconfigured lane.

entry_policy.normal_movement: When package, target and capable coder are recognizable, offer the available project start with the smallest truthful effect and recovery preview.
entry_policy.expanded_entry_condition: Explain possibilities or ask a bounded question only when a missing or corrected relation changes the proposed integration or first useful movement.
entry_policy.operator_correction_rule: Preserve a correction only when it materially changes target-owned startup; do not create an empty semantic handoff.
entry_policy.future_form_rule: The current direct action, dialogue, skill, harness and technology are owner-native incarnations, not limits on future entry forms.
